text:
incident-bot: Paging: elevated SRV lookup error rate for service discovery (CoreDNS) in us-east-1a · alerts/SD-SRV-ERR · priority: P1

dana_oncall: saw this hit during the last deploy? getting a flood of 5xxs for internal service discovery calls. paging me at 02:00 UTC.

alice_sre: I'm seeing ~60% SRV lookup failures from our app pods in us-east-1a -> affects Dedicated backends and internal health checks. Traces show downstream failing fast with 'no SRV records'.

ben_net: any networking changes in us-east-1a? security group or egress ACLs? I don't see any config pushes in the last 3 hours.

claire_prod: customer-facing incidents: a few customers reported elevated 503s for realtime inference in us-east-1. Triage says it's tied to routing to dedicated pools in that AZ.

alice_sre: snippets: from an app pod in us-east-1a

```
# dig +short SRV _redwood._tcp.svc.cluster.local
# returns nothing (timeout) or NXDOMAIN intermittently
```

alice_sre: coreDNS pods show repeated upstream timeouts in logs: `plugin/forward: upstream 10.0.0.2:53 error: read udp 10.0.0.3:40321->10.0.0.2:53: i/o timeout`

devops-bot: deploy-bot reports no dns/coreDNS config changes in the window. Last deploy finished 1769900200.

ben_net: running tcpdump on node e-az1-03: I see TCP RSTs from the cloud egress NAT for outbound UDP/53 flows intermittently to the regional name servers. Also asymmetric routes for some packets.

dana_oncall: ok immediate mitigation plan: 1) fail traffic for SRV queries to us-east-1b/1c by updating coreDNS upstreams to use cross-AZ resolvers 2) scale coreDNS replicas in us-east-1a to 4 3) re-route Dedicated pool traffic to other AZs for degraded mode.

alice_sre: patching CoreDNS config to add fallback forwarders to us-east-1b resolvers now. applying configmap edit:

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  Corefile: |
    .:53 {
      forward . 10.0.0.2 10.0.0.3 10.0.1.2 10.0.2.2 {
        policy sequential
        max_fails 2
        health_check 5s
      }
      errors
      log
    }
```

alice_sre: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/coredns -n kube-system` -> restarting pods (rolling)

alice_sre: scaling to 4 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/coredns --replicas=4 -n kube-system`

ben_net: added temporary route policy to allow DNS egress to us-east-1b resolvers from the affected subnet (applied ACL exception). Watch for traffic spikes.

claire_prod: enabling degraded mode for dedicated customers in us-east-1a: will shift new allocations to us-east-1b/c, keep existing connections with warning banner. Notifying top customers now.

dana_oncall: running live checks:
```
# post-patch dig
$ dig +short SRV _redwood._tcp.svc.cluster.local @10.0.1.2
10 0 8080 host-a.example.internal.
10 0 8080 host-b.example.internal.
```

alice_sre: initial results look good -> SRV responses restored via cross-AZ forwarders. Error rate dropped from 60% -> ~2% over last 5m.

devops-bot: consul agents report: leader in us-east-1a showing high RTT and intermittent heartbeat misses. Starting leader election if issues persist.

ben_net: inspected cloud provider status: brief control plane maintenance triggered a mis-programming of egress firewall rules in us-east-1a (provider-side). That caused intermittent drops for UDP/53 and some TCP flows. Provider team rolling a fix.

dana_oncall: marking incident as mitigating: new status: Mitigated — fallback forwarders + coreDNS scaling + routing exception. Continuing to monitor 30m.

claire_prod: customer impact update sent to affected customers: we've shifted new allocations and mitigated DNS failures; some short-lived request retries may have affected inference quality for 2-4% of requests between 01:58-02:06 UTC.

alice_sre: follow-up tasks: 1) run full audit of CoreDNS forwarders and max_fails tuning 2) add playbook runbook entry for cross-AZ forwarder fallback 3) automate canary failover for SRV lookups 4) coordinate with cloud provider for RCA and provider-executed firewall rollback.

ben_net: opening cloud provider ticket PROD-5421 with our packet captures and AS path traces. Provider acknowledged misconfig and scheduled fix deployment.

dana_oncall: handing off to alice_sre for post-mitigation monitoring window. I'll be available for escalation.

alice_sre: taking over monitoring. Will post final closure once stable for 30m and errors <0.5%.

pagerduty: incident P1 acknowledged by dana_oncall and assigned to alice_sre.

alice_sre: 02:28 UTC update: healthy. error rate 0.12% over 20m. starting incident close timeline and will publish preliminary RCA to #postmortems in ~2 hours.

claire_prod: added customer support note and ticket tags. cc: legal/compliance for customers on dedicated private deployments.

devops-bot: recorded actions: coreDNS scaled -> 4, configmap updated, egress ACL exception applied, provider ticket PROD-5421 created.

alice_sre: closing this thread; RCA draft will include timeline, provider firewall mis-programming, and our mitigations (cross-AZ fallback + scaling + routing policy).

incident-bot: Incident mitigated — P1 reduced to P2 for monitoring. Final state: mitigated.
